page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top centre-left with page number at top right; a small Greek annotation beside the first lines inside the text block; closing words centred; FINIS centred below; a rule at the foot. page.notes: The Greek words after "1697." and after "2416" are small, partly faint annotations; "πανοι" and "Χοιὰκ" are uncertain and may be misread. The "ıƈ" beside 1697 is a Roman numeral marking, likely "ıƈ" for a Greek or Arabic-style numeral; doubtful. Lines 1 to 3 have a brace joining the numbers to the Greek annotation. The closing words "Soli DEO Gratia & Gloria. Amen." and "FINIS" are set apart and are not headings. Bottom of the page carries a faint "Digitized by Google" stamp, which is excluded.
